thread:
emily.k: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to turn the notes into clear remediation owners and timelines. I sketched a list, please ack or update.

raj.s: Ack. Can you paste the sketch here? I have bandwidth to own the infra changes this week.

emily.k: TL;DR: 1) Cloud provider AZ failover tests + routing policy (owner: raj.s, due: 2026-03-31) 2) Model registry caching + local fallback for critical models (owner: sasha.m, due: 2026-04-07) 3) Auth provider circuit breaker + retry policy (owner: marco_p, due: 2026-03-28) 4) Monthly vendor incident pattern review (owner: emily.k, recurring: monthly) 5) Postmortem follow-up review w/eng-sre & legal for SLA implications (owner: ingrid, due: 2026-04-10)

sasha.m: Added: implement a signed-tarball cache for top-10 production models in S3 (TTL 24h) so we can serve during model-registry blips. Will create GH issue and link here. ETA 2w.

raj.s: For AZ failover: propose health-check-based routing + a canary region. I can prototype the route policy and a playbook for oncall. Need help from eng-sre to test failover scenarios. @ingrid can we get a compliance signoff for testing cross-region routing?

ingrid: Compliance OK for non-prod. For prod we need a runbook and risk assessment. I'll take the runbook task and coordinate with platform security. Put the prod test plan in a ticket and tag me.

marco_p: Circuit breaker plan: add a token-level auth fallback using our short-lived API keys cached in Vault, drop to read-only token if provider slow > 500ms for 3 consecutive calls. I'll write config and a small lib change. Can someone review? @raj.s for infra impact.

emily.k: Great. Action tracking: I created INC-4532-FOLLOWUP in Jira and linked the postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4532 . Please add implementation check-ins to the ticket and set PRs to auto-close it.

sasha.m: GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/issues/129 — added checklist and owner. ETA 2026-04-07.

raj.s: Created infra RFC draft for routing policies: https://docs.redwood.internal/rfcs/az-routing-draft.md — comments welcome. I'll schedule a short sync on Mon.

ingrid: I'll create the prod risk assessment ticket and link to INC-4532 by EOD tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook review meeting scheduled for 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC (eng-sre, eng-infra, eng-ml).

emily.k: Recurring incident pattern note: model-registry auth flakiness has appeared 3 times in last 6 months. We should add automated alerts for auth error-rate spikes and surface them in the Ops dashboard. Who can pick this?

marco_p: I'll add Alert: model-registry.auth.error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m => P1 notify oncall and slack #incidents. ETA 3 days.

sasha.m: Also, adding a QA smoke test that validates model download + checksum post-deploy to catch regressed uploads. ETA 1 week.

raj.s: One more ask: can we define an SLO for model artifact availability (e.g., 99.9% monthly)? That gives procurement leverage with the registry vendor. @emily.k thoughts?

emily.k: Yes, include SLO proposal in INC-4532. Procurement + legal will use it with vendor SLA talks. I'll coordinate.

ingrid: Final: owners, deadlines, and PRs must be added to INC-4532 by 2026-03-27 or we escalate to leadership. :warning:

emily.k: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and ping when INC-4532 has all links. :thumbsup:
